    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">分布式链路追踪系统之skywalking 追踪案例</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        <img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1503305/202607/1503305-20260719234035782-1964648795.png" alt="分布式链路追踪系统之skywalking 追踪案例" class="desc_img">
        单体（Monolith）：所有功能打包成一个程序、一个进程，一次部署全部功能，共用一套数据库；微服务（Microservice）：按业务拆成多个独立小服务，每个服务独立进程、独立部署、可单独扩缩容，服务间通过 RPC/HTTP/ 消息队列通信。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h1 id="java服务案例">Java服务案例</h1>
<h2 id="基于tomcat运行jenkins实现链路跟踪案例">基于tomcat运行Jenkins实现链路跟踪案例</h2>
<p><strong>java基础环境准备</strong></p>
<h3 id="安装jdk">安装jdk</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash">root@tomcat-jenkins:~# apt install openjdk-11-jdk -y 
</code></pre>
<p><strong>验证java版本</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">root@tomcat-jenkins:~# java -version
openjdk version "11.0.31" 2026-04-21
OpenJDK Runtime Environment (build 11.0.31+11-post-1ubuntu1-22.04.2-Ubuntu)
OpenJDK 64-Bit Server VM (build 11.0.31+11-post-1ubuntu1-22.04.2-Ubuntu, mixed mode, sharing)
root@tomcat-jenkins:~#
</code></pre>
<h3 id="部署java-agent">部署Java agent</h3>
<p><strong>下载java agent</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">root@tomcat-jenkins:~# mkdir /skywalking-agent
root@tomcat-jenkins:~# cd /skywalking-agent
root@tomcat-jenkins:/skywalking-agent# wget https://archive.apache.org/dist/skywalking/java-agent/8.13.0/apache-skywalking-java-agent-8.13.0.tgz
--2026-08-16 06:12:09--  https://archive.apache.org/dist/skywalking/java-agent/8.13.0/apache-skywalking-java-agent-8.13.0.tgz
Resolving archive.apache.org (archive.apache.org)... 65.108.204.189, 2a01:4f9:1a:a084::2
Connecting to archive.apache.org (archive.apache.org)|65.108.204.189|:443... connected.
HTTP request sent, awaiting response... 200 OK
Length: 31443304 (30M) [application/x-gzip]
Saving to: ‘apache-skywalking-java-agent-8.13.0.tgz’

apache-skywalking-java-agent-8.13.0.tgz    100%[=======================================================================================&gt;]  29.99M  23.1KB/s    in 34m 6s  s

2026-08-16 06:46:17 (15.0 KB/s) - ‘apache-skywalking-java-agent-8.13.0.tgz’ saved [31443304/31443304]

root@tomcat-jenkins:/skywalking-agent# ls
apache-skywalking-java-agent-8.13.0.tgz
root@tomcat-jenkins:/skywalking-agent# 
</code></pre>
<h4 id="配置skywalking-agent参数">配置skywalking-agent参数</h4>
<p><strong>解压skywalking-agent</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-BASH">root@tomcat-jenkins:/skywalking-agent# tar xf apache-skywalking-java-agent-8.13.0.tgz 
root@tomcat-jenkins:/skywalking-agent# ls
apache-skywalking-java-agent-8.13.0.tgz  skywalking-agent
root@tomcat-jenkins:/skywalking-agent# 
</code></pre>
<p><strong>配置skywalking-agent</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-BASH">root@tomcat-jenkins:/skywalking-agent# grep -e agent.namespace= -e agent.service_name= -e  collector.backend_service= skywalking-agent/config/agent.config
agent.service_name=${SW_AGENT_NAME:tomcat-jenkins}
agent.namespace=${SW_AGENT_NAMESPACE:myapp}
collector.backend_service=${SW_AGENT_COLLECTOR_BACKEND_SERVICES:192.168.112.72:11800}
root@tomcat-jenkins:/skywalking-agent# 
</code></pre>
<h3 id="部署tomcat">部署tomcat</h3>
<h4 id="下载并解压tomcat">下载并解压tomcat</h4>
<pre><code class="language-BASH">root@tomcat-jenkins:/skywalking-agent# cd 
root@tomcat-jenkins:~# mkdir /apps
root@tomcat-jenkins:~# cd /apps
root@tomcat-jenkins:/apps# wget https://archive.apache.org/dist/tomcat/tomcat-8/v8.5.84/bin/apache-tomcat-8.5.84.tar.gz
--2026-08-16 07:06:53--  https://archive.apache.org/dist/tomcat/tomcat-8/v8.5.84/bin/apache-tomcat-8.5.84.tar.gz
Resolving archive.apache.org (archive.apache.org)... 65.108.204.189, 2a01:4f9:1a:a084::2
Connecting to archive.apache.org (archive.apache.org)|65.108.204.189|:443... connected.
HTTP request sent, awaiting response... 200 OK
Length: 10626063 (10M) [application/x-gzip]
Saving to: ‘apache-tomcat-8.5.84.tar.gz’

apache-tomcat-8.5.84.tar.gz                100%[=======================================================================================&gt;]  10.13M  26.5KB/s    in 5m 41s  

2026-08-16 07:12:35 (30.4 KB/s) - ‘apache-tomcat-8.5.84.tar.gz’ saved [10626063/10626063]

root@tomcat-jenkins:/apps# ls
apache-tomcat-8.5.84.tar.gz
root@tomcat-jenkins:/apps# tar xf apache-tomcat-8.5.84.tar.gz 
root@tomcat-jenkins:/apps# ls
apache-tomcat-8.5.84  apache-tomcat-8.5.84.tar.gz
root@tomcat-jenkins:/apps# 
</code></pre>
<h4 id="配置tomcat">配置tomcat</h4>
<pre><code class="language-BASH">root@tomcat-jenkins:/apps# grep -e "^CATALINA_OPTS" apache-tomcat-8.5.84/bin/catalina.sh
CATALINA_OPTS="$CATALINA_OPTS -javaagent:/skywalking-agent/skywalking-agent/skywalking-agent.jar"; export CATALINA_OPTS
root@tomcat-jenkins:/apps# 
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>这里主要在tomcat的启动脚本里加入skywalking-agent配置，用CATALINA_OPTS环境变量来指定skywalking-agent的jar包路径，然后导出环境变量；</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="部署jenkins">部署jenkins</h3>
<h4 id="上传jenkins-app并启动tomcat">上传Jenkins app并启动tomcat</h4>
<p><strong>上传jenkins war包</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-BASH">root@tomcat-jenkins:/apps# ls
apache-tomcat-8.5.84  apache-tomcat-8.5.84.tar.gz
root@tomcat-jenkins:/apps# cd apache-tomcat-8.5.84/webapps/
root@tomcat-jenkins:/apps/apache-tomcat-8.5.84/webapps# ls
ROOT  docs  examples  host-manager  manager
root@tomcat-jenkins:/apps/apache-tomcat-8.5.84/webapps# rz
rz waiting to receive.
 zmodem trl+C ȡ

  100%   89059 KB 44529 KB/s 00:00:02       0 Errors

root@tomcat-jenkins:/apps/apache-tomcat-8.5.84/webapps# ls
ROOT  docs  examples  host-manager  jenkins.war  manager
root@tomcat-jenkins:/apps/apache-tomcat-8.5.84/webapps# 
</code></pre>
<p><strong>启动tomcat</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">root@tomcat-jenkins:/apps/apache-tomcat-8.5.84/webapps# /apps/apache-tomcat-8.5.84/bin/catalina.sh run
</code></pre>
<h2 id="验证">验证</h2>
<h3 id="验证tomcat端口监听情况">验证tomcat端口监听情况</h3>
<pre><code class="language-BASH">root@tomcat-jenkins:~# ss -tnlp
State          Recv-Q         Send-Q                      Local Address:Port                 Peer Address:Port        Process                                              
LISTEN         0              4096                        127.0.0.53%lo:53                        0.0.0.0:*            users:(("systemd-resolve",pid=38238,fd=14))         
LISTEN         0              128                               0.0.0.0:22                        0.0.0.0:*            users:(("sshd",pid=15809,fd=3))                     
LISTEN         0              100                                     *:8080                            *:*            users:(("java",pid=117129,fd=178))                  
LISTEN         0              1                      [::ffff:127.0.0.1]:8005                            *:*            users:(("java",pid=117129,fd=297))                  
root@tomcat-jenkins:~# 
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>能够正常看到tomcat8080端口处于监听状况，表示tomcat已经正常运行起来了</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="验证jenkins-web界面">验证jenkins web界面</h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1503305/202608/1503305-20260816153311043-2096531183.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<p>访问tomcat主机IP地址端口加上对应应用名称，如果能够看到上面jenkins的导入密钥画面，表示jenkins已经正常运行，接下来就直接导入密钥，安装jenkins即可；</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="验证skywalking-数据">验证skywalking 数据</h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1503305/202608/1503305-20260816154241970-476143484.gif" alt="qq2026816-153828000000-000035" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<p>如上图所示，能够正常在skywalking web上看到链路追踪数据，说明skywalking agent在tomcat上正常运行；</p>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="dubbo微服务实现链路跟踪案例">dubbo微服务实现链路跟踪案例</h2>
<h3 id="微服务与单体服务架构">微服务与单体服务架构</h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1503305/202608/1503305-20260816192656185-2079423440.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<p>单体（Monolith）：所有功能打包成一个程序、一个进程，一次部署全部功能，共用一套数据库；微服务（Microservice）：按业务拆成多个独立小服务，每个服务独立进程、独立部署、可单独扩缩容，服务间通过 RPC/HTTP/ 消息队列通信。</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="部署注册中心zookeeper">部署注册中心zookeeper</h3>
<p><strong>java环境准备</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-BASH">root@dubbo-zookeeper:~# apt install openjdk-8-jdk -y
</code></pre>
<p><strong>验证Java版本</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-BASH">root@dubbo-zookeeper:~# java -version
openjdk version "1.8.0_492"
OpenJDK Runtime Environment (build 1.8.0_492-8u492-ga~us2-0ubuntu1~22.04.1-b09)
OpenJDK 64-Bit Server VM (build 25.492-b09, mixed mode)
root@dubbo-zookeeper:~#
</code></pre>
<p><strong>下载zookeeper</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-BASH">root@dubbo-zookeeper:~# mkdir /apps &amp;&amp; cd /apps
root@dubbo-zookeeper:/apps# wget https://downloads01-he-fi.apache.org/zookeeper/zookeeper-3.7.2/apache-zookeeper-3.7.2-bin.tar.gz
--2026-08-16 11:43:42--  https://downloads01-he-fi.apache.org/zookeeper/zookeeper-3.7.2/apache-zookeeper-3.7.2-bin.tar.gz

Connecting to downloads01-he-fi.apache.org (downloads01-he-fi.apache.org)|95.216.224.44|:443... connected.
HTTP request sent, awaiting response... 200 OK
Length: 14198607 (14M) [application/x-gzip]
Saving to: ‘apache-zookeeper-3.7.2-bin.tar.gz’

root@dubbo-zookeeper:/apps# 
</code></pre>
<p><strong>解压并启动zookeeper</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-BASH">root@dubbo-zookeeper:/apps# ls

<blockquote>
<p>能够看到2181端口处于正常监听状态，说明zookeeper部署好了；生产一般情况zookeeper是一个高可用集群,有关zookeeper集群部署可以参考本人博客<a href="" rel="noopener nofollow">https://www.cnblogs.com/qiuhom-1874/p/13841371.html</a>；</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="部署provider">部署provider</h3>
<p><strong>Java环境准备</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-BASH">root@dubbo-provider:~# apt install -y openjdk-8-jdk
</code></pre>
<p><strong>验证Java版本</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-BASH">root@dubbo-provider:~# java -version
openjdk version "1.8.0_492"
OpenJDK Runtime Environment (build 1.8.0_492-8u492-ga~us2-0ubuntu1~22.04.1-b09)
OpenJDK 64-Bit Server VM (build 25.492-b09, mixed mode)
root@dubbo-provider:~#
</code></pre>
<p><strong>下载skywalking-agent</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-BASH">root@dubbo-provider:~# mkdir /skywalking-agent &amp;&amp; cd /skywalking-agent
root@dubbo-provider:/skywalking-agent# wget https://archive.apache.org/dist/skywalking/java-agent/8.13.0/apache-skywalking-java-agent-8.13.0.tgz
</code></pre>
<p><strong>解压并配置skywalking-agent</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-BASH">root@dubbo-provider:/skywalking-agent# ls
apache-skywalking-java-agent-8.13.0.tgz
root@dubbo-provider:/skywalking-agent# tar xf apache-skywalking-java-agent-8.13.0.tgz 
root@dubbo-provider:/skywalking-agent# ls
apache-skywalking-java-agent-8.13.0.tgz  skywalking-agent
root@dubbo-provider:/skywalking-agent# cd skywalking-agent/
root@dubbo-provider:/skywalking-agent/skywalking-agent# ls
LICENSE  NOTICE  activations  bootstrap-plugins  config  licenses  logs  optional-plugins  optional-reporter-plugins  plugins  skywalking-agent.jar
root@dubbo-provider:/skywalking-agent/skywalking-agent# cd config/
root@dubbo-provider:/skywalking-agent/skywalking-agent/config# grep -e agent.namespace= -e agent.service_name= -e  collector.backend_service= agent.config
agent.service_name=${SW_AGENT_NAME:dubbo-provider}
agent.namespace=${SW_AGENT_NAMESPACE:myapp}
collector.backend_service=${SW_AGENT_COLLECTOR_BACKEND_SERVICES:192.168.112.72:11800}
root@dubbo-provider:/skywalking-agent/skywalking-agent/config# 
</code></pre>
<p><strong>上传dubbo-provider jar包</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-BASH">root@dubbo-provider:~# mkdir /apps &amp;&amp; cd /apps
root@dubbo-provider:/apps# rz
rz waiting to receive.
 zmodem trl+C ȡ

  100%   13966 KB 13966 KB/s 00:00:01       0 Errors

root@dubbo-provider:/apps# ls
dubbo-server.jar
root@dubbo-provider:/apps# 
</code></pre>
<p><strong>添加主机名解析</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">root@dubbo-provider:/apps# cat /etc/profile
# /etc/profile: system-wide .profile file for the Bourne shell (sh(1))
# and Bourne compatible shells (bash(1), ksh(1), ash(1), ...).

export ZK_SERVER1=192.168.112.76

if [ "${PS1-}" ]; then
  if [ "${BASH-}" ] &amp;&amp; [ "$BASH" != "/bin/sh" ]; then
    # The file bash.bashrc already sets the default PS1.
    # PS1='\h:\w\$ '
    if [ -f /etc/bash.bashrc ]; then
      . /etc/bash.bashrc
    fi
  else
    if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; then
      PS1='# '
    else
      PS1='$ '
    fi
  fi
fi

if [ -d /etc/profile.d ]; then
  for i in /etc/profile.d/*.sh; do
    if [ -r $i ]; then
      . $i
    fi
  done
  unset i
fi
root@dubbo-provider:/apps# source /etc/profile
root@dubbo-provider:/apps# echo $ZK_SERVER1
192.168.112.76
root@dubbo-provider:/apps# 
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>这里之所以要给ZK_SERVER1 赋值原因是provider里面配置文件通过这个环境变量来指定zookeeper地址；</p>
</blockquote>
<p><strong>启动provider</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-BASH">root@dubbo-provider:/apps# java -javaagent:/skywalking-agent/skywalking-agent/skywalking-agent.jar -jar /apps/dubbo-server.jar 
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1503305/202608/1503305-20260816202508160-780763094.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<p>能够看到服务已经启动，表示provider启动成功；</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="部署consumer">部署consumer</h3>
<p><strong>Java环境准备</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-BASH">root@dubbo-consumer:~# apt install -y openjdk-8-jdk
</code></pre>
<p><strong>验证java版本</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-BASH">root@dubbo-consumer:~# java -version
openjdk version "1.8.0_492"
OpenJDK Runtime Environment (build 1.8.0_492-8u492-ga~us2-0ubuntu1~22.04.1-b09)
OpenJDK 64-Bit Server VM (build 25.492-b09, mixed mode)
root@dubbo-consumer:~# 
</code></pre>
<p><strong>下载skywalking-agent</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-BASH">root@dubbo-consumer:~# mkdir /skywalking-agent &amp;&amp; cd /skywalking-agent
root@dubbo-consumer:/skywalking-agent# wget https://archive.apache.org/dist/skywalking/java-agent/8.13.0/apache-skywalking-java-agent-8.13.0.tgz
</code></pre>
<p><strong>解压并配置skywalking-agent</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-BASH">root@dubbo-consumer:/skywalking-agent# ls
apache-skywalking-java-agent-8.13.0.tgz
root@dubbo-consumer:/skywalking-agent# tar xf apache-skywalking-java-agent-8.13.0.tgz 
root@dubbo-consumer:/skywalking-agent# ls
apache-skywalking-java-agent-8.13.0.tgz  skywalking-agent
root@dubbo-consumer:/skywalking-agent# cd skywalking-agent/
root@dubbo-consumer:/skywalking-agent/skywalking-agent# cd config/
root@dubbo-consumer:/skywalking-agent/skywalking-agent/config# grep -e agent.namespace= -e agent.service_name= -e  collector.backend_service= agent.config
agent.service_name=${SW_AGENT_NAME:dubbo-comsumer}
agent.namespace=${SW_AGENT_NAMESPACE:myapp}
collector.backend_service=${SW_AGENT_COLLECTOR_BACKEND_SERVICES:192.168.112.72:11800}
root@dubbo-consumer:/skywalking-agent/skywalking-agent/config# 
</code></pre>
<p><strong>上传dubbo-consumer jar包</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">root@dubbo-consumer:~# mkdir /apps &amp;&amp; cd /apps
root@dubbo-consumer:/apps# rz
rz waiting to receive.
 zmodem trl+C ȡ

  100%   21170 KB 21170 KB/s 00:00:01       0 Errors

root@dubbo-consumer:/apps# ls
dubbo-client.jar
root@dubbo-consumer:/apps# 
</code></pre>
<p><strong>添加主机名解析</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-BASH">root@dubbo-consumer:/apps# cat /etc/profile
# /etc/profile: system-wide .profile file for the Bourne shell (sh(1))
# and Bourne compatible shells (bash(1), ksh(1), ash(1), ...).

export ZK_SERVER1=192.168.112.76

if [ "${PS1-}" ]; then
  if [ "${BASH-}" ] &amp;&amp; [ "$BASH" != "/bin/sh" ]; then
    # The file bash.bashrc already sets the default PS1.
    # PS1='\h:\w\$ '
    if [ -f /etc/bash.bashrc ]; then
      . /etc/bash.bashrc
    fi
  else
    if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; then
      PS1='# '
    else
      PS1='$ '
    fi
  fi
fi

if [ -d /etc/profile.d ]; then
  for i in /etc/profile.d/*.sh; do
    if [ -r $i ]; then
      . $i
    fi
  done
  unset i
fi
root@dubbo-consumer:/apps# source /etc/profile
root@dubbo-consumer:/apps# echo $ZK_SERVER1
192.168.112.76
root@dubbo-consumer:/apps# 
</code></pre>
<p><strong>启动comsumer</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-BASH">root@dubbo-consumer:/apps# java -javaagent:/skywalking-agent/skywalking-agent/skywalking-agent.jar -jar /apps/dubbo-client.jar 
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1503305/202608/1503305-20260816204652065-916650960.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<p>能够看到dubbo消费者端已经启动，表示dubbo-consumer就部署好了；</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="部署dubboadmin">部署dubboadmin</h3>
<p><strong>java 环境准备</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-BASH">root@dubboadmin:~# apt install openjdk-8-jdk -y
</code></pre>
<p><strong>验证Java 版本</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-BASH">root@dubboadmin:~# java -version
openjdk version "1.8.0_492"
OpenJDK Runtime Environment (build 1.8.0_492-8u492-ga~us2-0ubuntu1~22.04.1-b09)
OpenJDK 64-Bit Server VM (build 25.492-b09, mixed mode)
root@dubboadmin:~# 
</code></pre>
<p><strong>安装tomcat</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-BASH">root@dubboadmin:~# mkdir /apps &amp;&amp; cd /apps
root@dubboadmin:/apps# wget https://archive.apache.org/dist/tomcat/tomcat-8/v8.5.84/bin/apache-tomcat-8.5.84.tar.gz
</code></pre>
<p><strong>解压tomcat</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-BASH">root@dubboadmin:/apps# ls
apache-tomcat-8.5.84.tar.gz
root@dubboadmin:/apps# tar xf apache-tomcat-8.5.84.tar.gz 
root@dubboadmin:/apps# ls
apache-tomcat-8.5.84  apache-tomcat-8.5.84.tar.gz
root@dubboadmin:/apps# ln -s  apache-tomcat-8.5.84 tomcat
root@dubboadmin:/apps# ll
total 10392
drwxr-xr-x  3 root root     4096 Aug 16 13:31 ./
drwxr-xr-x 20 root root     4096 Aug 16 13:28 ../
drwxr-xr-x  9 root root     4096 Aug 16 13:31 apache-tomcat-8.5.84/
-rw-r--r--  1 root root 10626063 Aug 16 13:30 apache-tomcat-8.5.84.tar.gz
lrwxrwxrwx  1 root root       20 Aug 16 13:31 tomcat -&gt; apache-tomcat-8.5.84/
root@dubboadmin:/apps# 
</code></pre>
<p><strong>上传dubboadmin至tomcat 的webapp目录</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-BASH">root@dubboadmin:/apps# cd tomcat/webapps/
root@dubboadmin:/apps/tomcat/webapps# ls
ROOT  docs  examples  host-manager  manager
root@dubboadmin:/apps/tomcat/webapps# rz
rz waiting to receive.
 zmodem trl+C ȡ

  100%   27126 KB 27126 KB/s 00:00:01       0 Errors

root@dubboadmin:/apps/tomcat/webapps# ls
ROOT  docs  dubboadmin.war  examples  host-manager  manager
root@dubboadmin:/apps/tomcat/webapps# 
</code></pre>
<p><strong>解压dubboadmin.war</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-BASH">root@dubboadmin:/apps/tomcat/webapps# unzip dubboadmin.war 
</code></pre>
<p><strong>修改配置</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-BASH">root@dubboadmin:/apps/tomcat/webapps# cat dubboadmin/WEB-INF/dubbo.properties
dubbo.registry.address=zookeeper://192.168.112.76:2181
dubbo.admin.root.password=root
dubbo.admin.guest.password=guest
root@dubboadmin:/apps/tomcat/webapps# 
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>这里需要配置zookeeper的IP地址，以及root和guest登录密码；</p>
</blockquote>
<p><strong>启动tomcat</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-BASH">root@dubboadmin:/apps/tomcat/webapps# /apps/tomcat/bin/catalina.sh  run
</code></pre>

<h1 id="python服务案例">Python服务案例</h1>
<h2 id="基于django项目追踪案例">基于Django项目追踪案例</h2>

本案例基于Ubuntu 20.04，python3.8<br>

</code></pre>

root@python-agent:/apps/django-test# 
</code></pre>
<h3 id="创建django项目mysite">创建django项目mysite</h3>
<pre><code class="language-BASH">root@python-agent:/apps/django-test# django-admin startproject mysite
CommandError: '/apps/django-test/mysite' already exists
root@python-agent:/apps/django-test# rm -rf mysite
root@python-agent:/apps/django-test# django-admin startproject mysite
root@python-agent:/apps/django-test# ls
bin  include  lib  mysite  pyvenv.cfg  requirements.txt
root@python-agent:/apps/django-test# 
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>这里报错的原因是/apps/django-test/mysite 目录已经存在了，startproject 不能覆盖已有文件夹，直接报错。解决办法可以换个名称，或者删除对应文件夹，重新创建项目；</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="创建应用">创建应用</h3>
<pre><code class="language-BASH">root@python-agent:/apps/django-test# cd mysite/
root@python-agent:/apps/django-test/mysite# python3 manage.py startapp myapp
root@python-agent:/apps/django-test/mysite# 
</code></pre>

root@python-agent:/apps/django-test/mysite# export SW_AGENT_COLLECTOR_BACKEND_SERVICES='192.168.112.72:11800'

</code></pre>
